parameters.name: Language Selection
parameters.description: Sets the language for the LCD keypad.

parameters.name: Access Level Selection
parameters.description: Sets user access to parameters.

parameters.name: Control Method Selection
parameters.description: Sets the control method for the drive application and the motor.

parameters.name: Initialize Parameters
parameters.description: Resets parameters to default values.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: Entry point for the password set in A1-05. Enter the correct password to change parameter settings.

parameters.name: Password Setting
parameters.description: Set the password to lock parameters and prevent changes.

parameters.name: Application Preset
parameters.description: Sets the drive to operate in selected application conditions.

parameters.name: DriveWorksEZ Function Selection
parameters.description: Sets the drive to operate with DriveWorksEZ.

parameters.name: Firmware Update Lock
parameters.description: Protects the drive firmware. When enabled, you cannot update the firmware.

parameters.name: Bluetooth ID
parameters.description: Sets the password necessary to use Bluetooth to control the drive.

parameters.name: User Parameter Auto Selection
parameters.description: Sets the automatic save feature for changes to parameters A2-17 to A2-32.

parameters.name: Frequency Reference Selection 1
parameters.description: Sets the input method for the frequency reference.

parameters.name: Run Command Selection 1
parameters.description: Sets the input method for the Run command.

parameters.name: Stopping Method Selection
parameters.description: Sets the method to stop the motor after removing a Run command.

parameters.name: Reverse Operation Selection
parameters.description: Sets the reverse operation function. Disable in fan/pump applications where reverse is dangerous.

parameters.name: Digital Input Reading
parameters.description: Sets the number of times the drive reads the sequence input command to prevent electrical interference.

parameters.name: LOCAL/REMOTE Run Selection
parameters.description: Sets drive response to an existing Run command when receiving a second Run command from a different location.

parameters.name: Phase Order Selection
parameters.description: Sets the phase order for output terminals U/T1, V/T2, and W/T3.

parameters.name: Frequency Reference Selection 2
parameters.description: Sets the input method for frequency reference 2.

parameters.name: Run Command Selection 2
parameters.description: Sets the input method for Run Command 2 when switching control sources.

parameters.name: DC Injection/Zero Speed Threshold
parameters.description: Sets the frequency to start DC Injection Braking or Short Circuit Braking.

parameters.name: DC Injection Braking Current
parameters.description: Sets the DC Injection Braking current as a percentage of the drive rated current.

parameters.name: Speed Search at Start Selection
parameters.description: Sets the Speed Search at Start function.

parameters.name: Timer Function ON Delay Time
parameters.description: Sets the ON-delay time for the timer input.

parameters.name: Timer Function OFF Delay Time
parameters.description: Sets the OFF-delay time for the timer input.

parameters.name: PID Mode Setting
parameters.description: Sets the type of PID control.

parameters.name: Proportional Gain (P)
parameters.description: Sets the proportional gain (P) that is applied to PID input.

parameters.name: Integral Time (I)
parameters.description: Sets the integral time (I) that is applied to PID input.

parameters.name: Energy Saving Control Selection
parameters.description: Sets the Energy-saving control function.

parameters.name: Acceleration Time 1
parameters.description: Sets the length of time to accelerate from zero to maximum output frequency.

parameters.name: Deceleration Time 1
parameters.description: Sets the length of time to decelerate from maximum output frequency to zero.

parameters.name: Fast Stop Time
parameters.description: Sets the length of time that the drive will decelerate to zero for a Fast Stop.

parameters.name: S-Curve Time @ Start of Accel
parameters.description: Sets the S-curve acceleration time at start.

parameters.name: Normal/Heavy Duty Selection
parameters.description: Sets the drive duty rating.

parameters.name: Carrier Frequency Selection
parameters.description: Sets the carrier frequency for the transistors in the drive.

parameters.name: Reference 1
parameters.description: Sets the frequency reference 1.

parameters.name: Reference 2
parameters.description: Sets the frequency reference 2.

parameters.name: Jog Reference
parameters.description: Sets the Jog frequency reference.

parameters.name: Frequency Reference Upper Limit
parameters.description: Sets maximum limit for all frequency references.

parameters.name: Frequency Reference Lower Limit
parameters.description: Sets minimum limit for all frequency references.

parameters.name: Input AC Supply Voltage
parameters.description: Sets the drive input voltage.

parameters.name: V/f Pattern Selection
parameters.description: Sets the V/f pattern for the drive and motor.

parameters.name: Maximum Output Frequency
parameters.description: Sets the maximum output frequency for the V/f pattern.

parameters.name: Motor Rated Current (FLA)
parameters.description: Sets the motor rated current in amps.

parameters.name: PM Motor Code Selection
parameters.description: Sets the motor code for Yaskawa PM motors.

parameters.name: Motor Type Selection
parameters.description: Sets the type of motor.

parameters.name: Communication Error Selection
parameters.description: Sets the method to stop the motor when the drive detects a communication error.

parameters.name: IP Address 1
parameters.description: Sets the first octet of the IP Address.

parameters.name: IP Address 2
parameters.description: Sets the second octet of the IP Address.

parameters.name: Address Mode at Startup
parameters.description: Sets the method to set option card IP addresses.

parameters.name: Terminal S1 Function Selection
parameters.description: Sets the function for MFDI terminal S1.

parameters.name: Terminal S2 Function Selection
parameters.description: Sets the function for MFDI terminal S2.

parameters.name: Terminal S3 Function Selection
parameters.description: Sets the function for MFDI terminal S3.

parameters.name: Terminal S4 Function Selection
parameters.description: Sets the function for MFDI terminal S4.

parameters.name: Terminal S5 Function Selection
parameters.description: Sets the function for MFDI terminal S5.

parameters.name: Terminal S6 Function Selection
parameters.description: Sets the function for MFDI terminal S6.

parameters.name: Terminal S7 Function Selection
parameters.description: Sets the function for MFDI terminal S7.
